subject: More CMake / Build improvements (#70)
reason: The change is purely build/CI tooling: build.sh refactoring (auto-reconfigure detection, ninja/ninja-build selection, dumping test output on failure), a new CI flag, devcontainer and docs updates for libsystemd-dev, submodule checkout hint paths, and a CMake rule linking libsystemd into the module. No module source code changes: no command, reply, indexing, persistence, or replication behavior is affected, and the added systemd library is linked but never called by any changed code, so there is no runtime behavior for a scenario to exercise or compare.
